results.title: GLEIF (Global Legal Entity Identifier Foundation) | Regulatory ...
results.snippet: Summary The Global Legal Entity Identifier Foundation (GLEIF) is a non-profit organisation founded in Basel, Switzerland in 2014 that oversees the global system for issuing and managing Legal Entity Identifiers (LEIs). It operates under the oversight of the LEI Regulatory Oversight Committee (LEI ROC).
